scripts.dev:start: bun run env:run -- sh -c 'bun run dev:ng serve --port "$APP_HOST_PORT"'
scripts.build:app: NG_BUILD_PARTIAL_SSR=1 bun run dev:ng build && bun run build:ops
scripts.build:ops: bun run build:ops:schema && bun run build:ops:prerequisites && bun run build:ops:reset && bun run build:ops:seed
scripts.build:watch: NG_BUILD_PARTIAL_SSR=1 bun run dev:ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.test:integration:postgres:local: POSTGRES_INTEGRATION_DISPOSABLE=true bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh postgres-integration -- bun helpers/testing/run-postgres-integration.ts --local
scripts.test:e2e:check: bun run env:run -- bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts playwright
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:e2e:check && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-baseline PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-baseline DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- playwright test --project=local-chrome-baseline
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bun run test:e2e:check && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=setup PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=setup DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- playwright test --project=setup --trace=off && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-baseline PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-baseline DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images PLAYWRIGHT_SAFE_UI_BASELINE=1 bun run env:run -- playwright test --ui
scripts.test:e2e:integration: bun run test:e2e:check && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-integration,docs-integration PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-integration,docs-integration DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- playwright test --project=local-chrome-integration --project=docs-integration
scripts.test:e2e:live-esncard: DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts esncard-release && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-live-esncard,docs-live-esncard PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-live-esncard,docs-live-esncard DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- playwright test tests/specs/profile/user-profile-live-esncard.spec.ts tests/docs/profile/discounts.doc.ts --project=local-chrome-live-esncard --project=docs-live-esncard --grep '@needs-live-esncard'
scripts.test:e2e:live-esncard:release: DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts esncard-release && bun run test:unit:esncard-provider-error && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-live-esncard,docs-live-esncard PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=local-chrome-live-esncard,docs-live-esncard DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- playwright test tests/specs/profile/user-profile-live-esncard.spec.ts tests/docs/profile/discounts.doc.ts --project=local-chrome-live-esncard --project=docs-live-esncard --grep '@needs-live-esncard' --trace=off --reporter=./tests/support/reporters/protected-value-sanitizer-reporter.ts,github,dot,./tests/support/reporters/complete-playwright-run-reporter.ts
scripts.test:e2e:docs: bun run test:e2e:check && E2E_SELECTED_PROJECTS=docs-baseline PLAYWRIGHT_SELECTED_PROJECTS=docs-baseline DOCS_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs DOCS_IMG_OUT_DIR=test-results/docs/images bun run env:run -- playwright test --project=docs-baseline
scripts.db:push: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh database-push -- drizzle-kit push --force
scripts.db:studio: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh database-studio -- drizzle-kit studio
scripts.db:reset: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh database-reset -- sh -c 'STAGING_SEED_PREFLIGHT_ONLY=true bun helpers/database.ts && LOCAL_DATABASE_CONFIRM_RESET=evorto-local-reset bun helpers/reset-database-schema.ts && bun ./node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs push --force && bun helpers/database.ts'
scripts.docker:check: bun run env:run -- bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts docker
scripts.docker:ps: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/docker-stack.sh status
scripts.docker:stop: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh docker-stop -- bash helpers/testing/docker-stack.sh stop
scripts.docker:resume: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh docker-resume -- sh -c 'bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts docker && exec bash helpers/testing/docker-resume.sh'
scripts.docker:start: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh docker-start -- sh -c 'bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts docker && exec bash helpers/testing/docker-stack.sh start'
scripts.docker:start:watch: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh docker-start-watch -- sh -c 'bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts docker && exec bash helpers/testing/docker-stack.sh start-watch'
scripts.docker:start:foreground: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh docker-start-foreground -- sh -c 'bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts docker && exec bash helpers/testing/docker-stack.sh start-foreground'
scripts.docker:webserver: bun run env:run -- bash helpers/testing/with-docker-project-lease.sh docker-webserver -- sh -c 'bun helpers/testing/runtime-preflight.ts docker && exec bash helpers/testing/docker-webserver.sh'
scripts.deps:update:drizzle: bun add drizzle-orm@rc && bun add -D drizzle-seed@rc drizzle-kit@rc
